title.zh: 授权菲律宾共和国总统Elpidio Quirino阁下接受中国政府在其担任菲律宾副总统期间授予的卿云勋章大绶的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing His Excellency, Elpidio Quirino, President of the Republic of the Philippines, to Accept the Order of the "Grand Cordon of the Order of Propitious Clouds" Offered to Him By the Chinese Government When He Was Vice-President of the Philippines
title.orig: An Act Authorizing His Excellency, Elpidio Quirino, President of the Republic of the Philippines, to Accept the Order of the "Grand Cordon of the Order of Propitious Clouds" Offered to Him By the Chinese Government When He Was Vice-President of the Philippines

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1949/ra_348_1949.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: For the purpose of promoting international friendship and understanding, His Excellency, Elpidio Quirino, President of the Republic of the Philippines, is authorized to accept the order of the "Grand Cordon of the Order of Propitious Clouds" offered to him by the Chinese Government when he was Vice-President of the Philippines and to wear the insignia of the Order.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, March 24, 1949.
